analyst.summary: Aether Industries is a specialty-chemicals company with a genuinely niche product portfolio and blue-chip global clients, growing revenue at a strong clip on the back of heavy, ongoing capacity expansion. However, returns on capital remain low (under 10% ROE) while the stock trades at a rich ~85x earnings and roughly 8x book value, and free cash flow is still negative as debt rises to fund growth. We rate this a Hold: the growth story is credible, but the valuation already assumes a return-on-capital improvement that has not yet shown up in the numbers.
